requirements.text: Loop-first work posture: the codex/supervisor loop does the work; the main session only monitors. Every piece of work the certified supervisor loop can currently perform (producing, unit execution, supervisor-run reviewing per D-033) flows through the loop, never through main-session hand-execution. The main session restricts itself to: monitoring the loop, restarting it, contracting/feeding task queues, and the control-plane actions that ADR-005 reserves to the orchestrator (recording gates, acceptance, git/gh) until the D-033 R595 activation transfers them.
requirements.required_evidence: supervisor journal shows units executed by the loop; main-session transcript shows monitoring/feeding only (no hand-implementation of loop-eligible work)

requirements.text: Nonstop duty (restates D-033-R009): if the loop shuts down, power it back up immediately. Established procedure: verify supervisor.lock pid liveness; deny stale asks in BOTH stores (pending-approvals/deny verbs WITH --checkout C:\SupervisorController, AND journal queued_asks); clear-recovery if PAUSED_RECOVERY; relaunch from the certified cwd (wt-controller-src at certified a5886dab until the R247 recert/reinstall lands - never ctl24 cwd before that); keep a read-only break watcher armed. Never run audit-writing operator verbs against a LIVE run.
requirements.required_evidence: break-watcher armed each session; on any loop death, a relaunch recorded with the denied-asks and clear-recovery evidence

requirements.text: Owner intent on loop scope: the loop's work includes reviewing and pushing anything that needs to be done. Interpretation bound (recorded, not silently applied): supervisor-run gate waves/acceptance and live GitHub effects (push/merge) remain behind the D-033 staged R595 activation path, which stays owner-only, and the Am40 local-only push hold stands until the owner activates or lifts it; this requirement therefore directs planning - the T-B/T-C successor queue must be designed to close the remaining activation facts (R754 facts 3 and 7) so the loop can take over reviewing and pushing under its own certified authority. This row does not itself activate R595, lift Am40, or authorize main-session pushes.
requirements.required_evidence: T-B/T-C queue contracted with R754-facts-3+7 closure as an explicit design goal; R595 activation package kept staged for the owner

requirements.text: Rotation: sessions rotate at the approximately-400,000-token seam (restates the D-010 R113/R114 rotate-at-~400k-at-a-clean-seam ceiling; the D-031 750k grant was one-session-only and does not apply). 'And so on' = the established mechanics: land at a clean seam, produce the session handoff, and the successor session keeps the loop nonstop (rotation continues the loop, it never just stops it).
requirements.required_evidence: session handoffs produced at ~400k seams; successor sessions re-verify loop liveness as their first action
